caption: The drawing depicts a suspended light fixture or chandelier composed of predominantly straight, geometric lines. The structure is made up of a central vertical rod which supports an octagonal, horizontally-oriented shade at the top. The shade is ribbed, giving the appearance of a pleated or ridged surface, and is shaded to suggest a metallic or glass material. Four arms extend perpendicular from the vertical rod, each arm ending in a holder for a vertical candle-like object. These four holders are equidistant around the central rod. Each of the arms and the central rod are depicted in dark tones, suggesting a metal material. A chain runs from each candle holder up to the central rod, creating triangular shapes. The entire drawing is in monochrome, utilizing shades of black, gray, and white. The drawing is on an aged, light beige background and is enclosed within a rectangular border. The name "Mildred Ford" is inscribed in the lower-left corner.
title: Chandeleir
